capabilities._note: audio: none. Wan 2.2 makes no sound: every take is a mute mp4, whatever the shot's audio policy (it renders `silent`, with a note in the take), and assemble lays silence under it.

models._note: Glob patterns (case-insensitive) naming the files each model parameter of the binding takes, for the model identification that reads them; `family` is its id for the file header check (high vs low noise is decided by the name: the headers are identical). Tiers (docs/API.md): all required; no accelerator, so no `base`.

template._note: Wan 2.2 5B (TI2V) renders 4k+1 frames at 24 fps (the user's saved workflow saves at 24; the model card's 121 frames = 5 s at 24 fps is what it was trained on, so a longer shot is a warning, and past 241 frames, 10 s, it must be split). Width and height are multiples of 32 (Wan22ImageToVideoLatent's step: the 5B VAE compresses 16x); sizes that aren't legal are snapped down, then shrunk under 1280x704 (the model's optimal size).

recipe._note: Text to video, or image to video from an optional first keyframe (shot:<id>:first, Wan22ImageToVideoLatent's start_image); a shot without one renders from the prompt alone, so nothing ever blocks it: the fast, cheap choice for proxies, and where a wan22_i2v shot without a first frame can go. No identity references: subjects are written in words. No sound: every policy renders silent and says so.

policy_fallback.why: Wan 2.2 makes no sound (lay the soundtrack in at the edit)

size_hints.keyframe: the render size (any size works: it is scaled and centre-cropped to the frame)

binding._note: An API graph with the nodes of the user's saved Wan 2.2 5B workflow (image_to_video_wan22_5B.json: UNETLoader, ModelSamplingSD3, the UMT5 CLIPLoader, the 2.2 VAE, Wan22ImageToVideoLatent, KSampler, VAEDecode), ending in CreateVideo/SaveVideo instead of its WEBM/WEBP previews. patch_graph feeds the first keyframe into Wan22ImageToVideoLatent's start_image, or disconnects it for text to video. The workflow has no LoRA loader: one is inserted after the UNETLoader when a profile names LoRAs. H3SaveShot takes the place of CreateVideo/SaveVideo (no audio input: the mp4 is mute) at the job's fps.

presets._note: wan2.2_ti2v_5B_fp16, KSampler uni_pc / simple, cfg 5, shift 8 (ComfyUI's Wan 2.2 5B template; the user's saved copy has 30 steps and shift ~5). Final 1280x704 at 20 steps (the model's optimal size); proxy 640x352 at 12 steps, the cheap preview. Another target's series config block lends no size. The negative prompt is Wan's standard one from ComfyUI's Wan templates.
